title: HR & Operations Executive
description:
**Job Title**  
HR & Operations Executive – Recruitment, Payroll & Business Operations

**Job Description**

We are looking for an **HR & Operations Executive** to manage end-to-end human resources activities and support day-to-day business operations in a growing digital marketing agency.

This role offers hands-on experience across recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance, payroll, employee engagement, office administration, client coordination, sales support, and founder’s office operations. You will work closely with the founder, management, employees, clients, and internal teams to keep people processes and business operations running smoothly.

The ideal candidate should be organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple responsibilities while maintaining clear communication and consistent follow-ups.

**What You’ll Do**

**Human Resources & Recruitment**

* **Recruitment:** Plan hiring requirements with managers based on upcoming business and client needs. Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job portals. Maintain the company careers page, screen resumes, and manage AI-based candidate screening on the website.
* **Interview Coordination & Selection:** Schedule interviews, coordinate with hiring managers, conduct reference checks and background verification, discuss salary expectations, prepare offer letters, and follow up with selected candidates until they join.
* **Talent Pool Management:** Maintain a database of suitable candidates for current and future hiring requirements.
* **Employee Onboarding:** Prepare appointment letters, NDAs, and joining documents. Collect identity proofs, bank details, certificates, and other required records. Coordinate email accounts, software access, and devices for new employees.
* **Employee Induction:** Conduct first-day orientation covering company policies, services, processes, workplace expectations, and organisational culture.
* **Attendance, Leave & Payroll:** Track attendance, working hours, shift timings, and employee leave records. Maintain the annual holiday calendar and coordinate monthly payroll processing and salary slips.
* **Incentives & Reimbursements:** Calculate sales incentives and commissions, manage employee reimbursements and expense claims, and coordinate payroll-related information with the accounts team.
* **Employee Engagement:** Organise festival celebrations, birthday events, team outings, and team-building activities. Communicate internal announcements and important updates to employees.
* **Employer Branding:** Coordinate company culture posts on LinkedIn and Instagram, share employee achievements and stories, manage company reviews on Glassdoor and AmbitionBox, and represent the organisation at job fairs and college events.

**Office Administration & Business Operations**

* **Office Management:** Manage office supplies, vendors, housekeeping, visitors, and security coordination. Track company assets, including laptops and equipment, and organise business travel and event arrangements.
* **Client Onboarding:** Coordinate new client onboarding by collecting required documents and account access for Google Ads, Meta, and websites. Schedule kickoff meetings and coordinate with the relevant internal teams.
* **Client Experience:** Conduct monthly client satisfaction check-ins, manage feedback surveys, collect client reviews and testimonials for platforms such as Google, Clutch, and GoodFirms, and coordinate festival greetings and gifts for clients.
* **Client Documentation:** Maintain records of client contracts, NDAs, and renewal dates. Follow up with the relevant teams to ensure documentation and renewals are completed on time.
* **Sales Coordination:** Make initial calls to new enquiries, understand basic requirements, and schedule meetings for the sales team.
* **Marketing Support:** Collect information and performance data from internal teams for case studies. Format proposals, presentations, and company profiles, and prepare supporting documents for tenders and requests for proposals (RFPs).
* **Webinars & Events:** Coordinate registrations, reminders, schedules, and arrangements for webinars, company events, and other business activities.

**Founder’s Office & Management Support**

* Manage the founder’s calendar, schedule meetings, coordinate travel, and follow up on pending tasks.
* Coordinate with the accounts team regarding pending client payments and outstanding follow-ups.
* Track company subscriptions, registrations, licences, and renewals to ensure timely completion.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect updates, resolve pending tasks, and keep important business activities on schedule.

**Experience**

Candidates with relevant experience in HR operations, recruitment, payroll coordination, office administration, business operations, or executive assistance can apply.

Experience in a digital marketing agency, IT company, or other service-based business will be preferred. Candidates who can manage multiple responsibilities, learn new processes, and work independently are encouraged to apply.

**Who Can Apply**

* Candidates with good organisational, communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Candidates who can manage recruitment, interview scheduling, onboarding, and employee documentation.
* Candidates familiar with attendance tracking, leave management, payroll coordination, and employee records.
* Candidates comfortable coordinating with employees, managers, clients, vendors, and leadership.
* Candidates who can manage office administration, client onboarding, documentation, and routine business operations.
* Candidates with the ability to maintain accurate records, track deadlines, and handle multiple tasks efficiently.
* Candidates with clear written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Candidates comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and common office productivity tools.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

* Gain exposure to HR, recruitment, payroll, client experience, sales coordination, and business operations.
* Work directly with the founder and management team.
* Understand how a digital marketing agency operates across departments.
* Take ownership of varied responsibilities and contribute to improving internal processes.
* Build opportunities to grow into an HR Manager, HR & Operations Manager, or Business Operations Manager role as the company expands.

**Preferred Skills & Additional Advantages**

* Experience with HRMS and HR software such as Keka, Zoho People, greytHR, or similar platforms.
* Basic knowledge of payroll processes, Provident Fund (PF), Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), and related HR compliance.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency, IT company, or service-based organisation.
* Basic Canva skills for creating employee engagement and company culture posts.

**Skills**

HR Operations · Human Resource Management · Recruitment · Talent Acquisition · Resume Screening · Interview Coordination · Employee Onboarding · Employee Documentation · Attendance Management · Leave Management · Payroll Coordination · Employee Engagement · Employer Branding · Office Administration · Business Operations · Client Onboarding · Client Coordination · Vendor Management · Sales Coordination · Executive Assistance · Microsoft Excel · Google Sheets · HRMS · English Communication · Hindi Communication

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided

* Anand Vihar, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Job Title: Placement Manager – DDU-GKY & Skill Development Projects

**Job Location:** Moti Nagar Delhi  
**Department:** Placement & Business Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years in Placement / Skill Development / DDU-GKY / Government Skill Projects

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Placement Manager** to manage placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and various Skill Development Programs**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with employers, identifying suitable job opportunities, organizing recruitment drives and interviews, and ensuring successful placement of trained candidates in relevant industries and job roles.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **skill development and placement ecosystem**, excellent employer networking skills, and a proven ability to achieve placement targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and Skill Development Projects**.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with companies, employers, HR departments, recruiters and industry partners.
* Identify suitable employment opportunities based on candidates' **skills, qualifications, training and job profiles**.
* Generate new employer tie-ups and placement opportunities across relevant industries.
* Collect and understand employer manpower requirements and coordinate recruitment accordingly.
* Organize **job fairs, recruitment drives, walk-in interviews, campus interviews and employer selection processes**.
* Coordinate candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, documentation and joining formalities.
* Ensure maximum conversion of trained candidates into **successful placements and joining**.
* Maintain regular communication with placed candidates and employers for joining and retention tracking.
* Track placement data, joining status, salary details, employer details and candidate retention.
* Prepare MIS reports, placement reports and project-related documentation within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with Training Centre, Mobilization, MIS and Project teams to achieve overall project placement targets.
* Ensure placement activities are aligned with **DDU-GKY and applicable Skill Development Project guidelines/SOPs**.
* Conduct regular market research to identify new employment sectors, job roles and salary opportunities.
* Build a strong employer database and continuously expand the placement network.
* Support the organization in achieving project-wise placement, joining and retention targets.
* Handle employer and candidate grievances related to the placement process.

Required Skills

* Strong **Employer Relationship Management** skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong networking and business development abilities.
* Good knowledge of **placement processes and recruitment practices**.
* Understanding of **DDU-GKY / Skill Development / Government-funded skilling projects**.
* Ability to generate new placement opportunities and employer tie-ups.
* Strong follow-up and target-oriented approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Email and MIS reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and placement targets simultaneously.
* Strong team management and coordination skills.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* DDU-GKY / DDU-GKY 2.0 Projects
* Skill Development Projects
* Government Skill Development Programs
* Placement-linked training projects
* Training & Placement organizations
* NSDC / State Skill Mission / PMKVY-related projects
* Recruitment / Staffing / Manpower Industry
* Corporate HR / Employer Relations
* Job Fairs and Campus Recruitment

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of employer tie-ups generated
* Number of job opportunities generated
* Candidate interview and selection ratio
* Placement and joining percentage
* Average salary offered to candidates
* Candidate retention/continuation after joining
* Employer satisfaction
* Timely and accurate MIS/project reporting
* Achievement of project-wise placement targets

Education

**Bachelor's Degree** in any discipline is required.

MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing, Business Development or a related field will be an added advantage.

Salary

**₹25,000 – ₹50,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and project requirements.

**Performance-based incentives** may be provided for achieving placement and employer engagement targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a **target-oriented, proactive and well-connected placement professional** who can independently develop employer networks and convert trained candidates into meaningful employment opportunities.

Candidates with strong experience in **DDU-GKY, Skill Development Projects, Placement Management and Employer Tie-ups** will be given preference.

**Apply Now** if you have the experience and skills to build strong industry connections and successfully place trained candidates in suitable employment opportunities.

title: Enterprise Systems Intern
description:
**About Us:**
  
World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.

**Our mission and values:**

WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations. Our Values are Independence, Integrity, Impact, Care, Partnership.

**Our culture:**

WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.

**Job Highlight:**

We are part of the IT function responsible for managing enterprise systems that support **HR, Finance, and Payroll operations**, with Workday as the core platform.

We are looking for an intern to support day-to-day system operations, documentation, and basic functional tasks. This role is ideal for someone who wants hands-on exposure to how large organizations run critical business functions through technology.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **40% – System Support & Operations**

* Support day-to-day Workday operations and user support activities.
* Assist with data validation, report reviews, reconciliations, and audit activities.
* Help track, investigate, and follow up on system issues, tickets, and user requests.
* Support data clean-up, mass updates, and system maintenance activities.
* Maintain internal documentation, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.
* Assist with Workday release testing and post-deployment validation.
* Support reporting and dashboard validation to ensure data accuracy.

### **30% – Business Analysis**

* Support documentation of business processes across HR, Finance, and Payroll functions in Workday.
* Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements from stakeholders.
* Create process maps, SOPs, user guides, and functional documentation.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and test execution.
* Assist with reporting analysis and process improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand operational challenges and identify opportunities for efficiency.

### **30% – Technical Analysis & Integrations**

* Assist in analyzing Workday integrations and data flows between systems.
* Support validation of inbound and outbound data interfaces.
* Help document integration requirements, field mappings, and technical specifications.
* Work with XML, JSON, APIs, and data structures to support troubleshooting and analysis.
* Assist technical teams with testing, defect tracking, and issue resolution.
* Support root cause analysis for system and integration issues.

**Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in B.Tech, BCA, BBA, B.Com, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Communicates technical information effectively to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in a structured and process-driven environment.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Exposure to Workday, ERP, HRIS, or enterprise applications.
* Strong Excel skills including data validation, analysis, and reporting.
* Basic understanding of SQL, APIs, XML, or JSON.
* Familiarity with HR, Finance, Payroll, or business operations processes.
* Interest in enterprise systems, integrations, and digital transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new concepts quickly

**What You Will Learn**
-----------------------

* Workday HCM, Finance, Reporting, Security, and Integrations.
* Enterprise system administration and support.
* Business analysis and process optimization methodologies.
* Integration monitoring and technical troubleshooting.
* Best practices for supporting global enterprise applications.

**Stipend:** INR 25000/month

**Location:** New Delhi/Mumbai/ Bangalore

**How to Apply:**

Please submit a resume with a cover letter**.** You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.

Job Description – HR Manager

Experience: 3–4 Years

Employment Type \- Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible HR Manager to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment, statutory compliance, and employee relations. The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of Indian labour laws, PF \& ESIC, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to use AI tools to improve HR processes.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Payroll Management

\* Manage monthly payroll processing, including salary, deductions, incentives, and overtime.

\* Verify attendance, leave, late fines, and LOP before salary processing.

\* Coordinate with the Accounts Department for timely salary disbursement.

\* Handle employee salary queries and Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements.

2\. Attendance \& Leave Management

\* Monitor daily attendance, late coming, and absenteeism.

\* Manage leave applications, approvals, and leave records.

\* Ensure compliance with company attendance and leave policies.

\* Maintain accurate attendance and leave MIS reports.

3\. Statutory Compliance – PF \& ESIC

\* Manage monthly PF and ESIC\-related compliance and documentation.

\* Coordinate employee registrations, UAN, ECR, challans, and applicable statutory records.

\* Coordinate with PF/ESIC consultants and government authorities when required.

\* Maintain compliance records and ensure timely completion of applicable filings.

4\. Labour Law \& HR Compliance

\* Maintain practical knowledge of Indian labour laws and applicable employment regulations.

\* Implement HR policies as per company requirements and applicable laws.

\* Maintain employee records, statutory registers, and compliance documentation.

\* Support labour inspections, audits, and compliance\-related queries.

5\. Recruitment \& Hiring

\* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for various departments.

\* Prepare job descriptions, source candidates, screen resumes, and schedule interviews.

\* Coordinate with HODs for manpower requirements and selection.

\* Manage offer letters, joining formalities, onboarding, and induction.

6\. Employee Relations \& Problem Solving

\* Handle employee grievances and workplace\-related concerns professionally.

\* Resolve HR issues through effective communication and practical solutions.

\* Manage disciplinary actions, warning letters, and policy violations as per company policy.

\* Coordinate with management and HODs to resolve employee\-related problems.

7\. AI Tools \& HR Technology

\* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant HR software to improve HR productivity.

\* Utilize AI for drafting HR communications, job descriptions, HR policies, and reports.

\* Explore AI\-based solutions for recruitment, HR MIS, and process improvement.

\* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company data while using AI tools.

8\. HR Operations \& Reporting

\* Maintain employee files, HRMS records, and HR documentation.

\* Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, leave, payroll, recruitment, and attrition.

\* Manage employee joining, confirmation, transfer, and exit formalities.

\* Ensure HR policies and procedures are implemented effectively.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

\* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

\* 3–4 years of relevant experience in HR Operations or HR Management.

\* Strong practical knowledge of payroll, attendance, leave, PF, ESIC, and labour law compliance.

\* Good recruitment and employee relations experience.

\* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel, HRMS, and AI tools.

\* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and documentation skills.

\* Ability to manage multiple HR activities independently.

Job Description
**Business Partnering**


* Partner with business leaders to understand manpower, productivity and capability requirements.


* Translate business priorities into people plans and HR interventions.


* Participate in business reviews and provide people insights and recommendations.

  

  

**Workforce Planning**


* Support manpower planning and budgeting exercises.


* Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely closure of critical positions.


* Drive quality hiring and onboarding effectiveness.

  

  

**Employee Engagement \& Culture**


* Conduct employee connects, skip\-level meetings and focus group discussions.


* Drive employee engagement initiatives and recognition programs.


* Track engagement indicators and implement action plans.

  

  

**Performance Management**


* Support goal setting, mid\-year reviews and annual performance cycles.


* Enable managers to provide continuous feedback and coaching.


* Assist in performance improvement plans where required.

  

  

**Attrition \& Retention Management**


* Analyse attrition trends and recommend corrective actions.


* Conduct stay interviews for critical talent.


* Develop retention strategies for key roles and high performers.

  

  

**Employee Relations**


* Address employee concerns and ensure timely resolution.


* Support disciplinary cases, investigations and policy implementation.


* Promote a positive work environment and high employee trust.

  

  

**HR Analytics \& Reporting**


* **Track and analyse people metrics including:**


* Headcount
* Attrition
* Diversity
* Hiring
* Performance
* Engagement
* Performance
* Engagement
* Productivity indicators
* Present actionable insights to business leaders.
